headline: Adnoc L&S Vessel Attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Crew Member Missing
summary: An Adnoc Logistics & Services vessel came under attack in the Strait of Hormuz, leaving 11 sailors injured and one missing, underscoring ongoing Persian Gulf maritime threats.
why: Adnoc L&S is the maritime shipping unit of Abu Dhabi's state oil producer. Security disruptions in Hormuz threaten roughly one-fifth of global crude petroleum flows.

impacts.name: ADNOC Logistics & Services
impacts.why: Vessel casualties and operational disruption in regional chokepoints increase insurance and risk costs.
